description: Utility helper functions for extracting and formatting credits data from API responses within a frontend project. Includes functions getCreditsUsed for safely retrieving credits values and formatCredits for locale-aware formatting.

methods.name: getCreditsUsed(details)
methods.description: Safely extracts credits used from API response details, handling different naming conventions (camelCase and snake_case), and nested data structures. Returns null if no valid number exists.

methods.name: formatCredits(value, locale = undefined)
methods.description: Formats a numeric credits value into a locale-aware string with proper decimal precision, or a placeholder if input is null or invalid.
